nl_prompt_interpreted.prompt: compare gross_revenue vs net_revenue across product_category where churn_flag is 1
nl_prompt_interpreted.generated_sql:
SELECT "product_category", SUM("gross_revenue") AS "gross_revenue", SUM("net_revenue") AS "net_revenue"
FROM "prism_table"
WHERE "churn_flag" = 1 AND "product_category" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "product_category"
